Playing AI Limit Part 1

📍 Singapore, Singapore 📅 August 30, 2026 📖 2 min read

Screenshot from AI Limits at Spirit Depths.

Tags: Gaming
Contents

Progression: The unlimited respec item, yay

So I was exploring for more weapons and stuff when I come across the infinite Respec crystal, in contrast to other simillar games thius game has infinite respec which is a dream come true. I felt like more games should just do this or do away with stats all together. Thanks to this I was able to try all sort of weird weapons like a literal road sign, and some of the high stat spells. Thanks to this I was able to explore quite the build variety and improve my damage.

Hunter of Bladers

Dying to her the first time gets you lock up in jail,kinda cool. Through the color plaette is rather simillar. Death:54 The most notable thing is this boss has her own sync meter as well making this the first offical duel boss, where she feels like the player character. I suspect that she is the flashback we see earlier, but it was a really challanging and fun fight. She is capable of parrying the player, and her attacks are fast but readable. I suspect that I could have beaten her a lot faster if I dont insist on parrying her as she kills me in 2-3 hits. Compared to other bosses the parrying return isn’t as great as well, because if she hits the player or parry the player she regain a god chunk of hey sync bar, I think each parry drops it by 35%, so to bring her down to the first fatal attack it takes 3 or so parry, and she is at 50% sync meter necessating 1-2 parry. There wasn’t any point where I felt that I died unfairly, and I was able to defeat her at the end. When she is near death she does start using items to restore her sync, so I find no point in parrying from here on.
